rationale: Reorganizes the whole General settings dialog into six responsive sections with shared controls, a compass, explanatory previews and integration-aware diagnostics. This is a visible workflow redesign compared with stable 1.81.0, while preserving configuration and plan rendering.

summary.ru: Общие настройки разделены на понятные разделы с компасом, примерами фона и подробными состояниями диагностики Zigbee. Диалог адаптируется к телефону и теме Home Assistant.
summary.en: General settings are organized into clear sections with a compass, background previews and explanatory Zigbee diagnostics. The dialog adapts to mobile screens and the Home Assistant theme.
